evidence: image: the left margin carries only the block-heart label 欽定四庫全書 / 前漢書 / 七. OCR ends '前漢書 / 次定曰事人三等'. The garbled 欽定四庫全書 contains 曰, so it reads as a quotation ('次定 said…') sitting directly after Yan Shigu's note, and the folio 七 is missing. It is not on the leaf as text.

English: '<note>Former Han Annals commentary by Ciding: "...serving others has three grades..."</note>'. The leaf has no such note, only the margin label 欽定四庫全書. A commentator and a doctrinal statement are invented, in the same note format as the real Yan Shigu notes.

image: the leaf opens with the small-character note 喙音許穢反, then 至本始之初. There is nothing like 一反已上 / 二言; those lines are garble from the 欽定四庫全書 margin. English invents '<note>Yan Shigu says: ...pronunciation is like yi combined with fan, as noted above. The two characters are combined.</note>'. The note is invented, but it is an empty fanqie remark attributed to the commentator who glosses every line of the page. It makes no claim about the history, and a reader learns nothing false about what the source says.

previous leaf ends '…遣太子嬰齊入宿衞謂'; this leaf opens '助曰國新被寇使者行矣胡方日夜裝入見天子' (image matches OCR). So King Hu says to Zhu: 'my state was just invaded; envoy, go on ahead; I am packing day and night to go and see the Son of Heaven'. English: 'Zhu said: "Our state has only recently suffered invasion. The envoy should depart; Hu is even now preparing…"'. The speaker is reversed: the Han envoy is given Hu's words and Hu's promise to go to court, which sets up the whole next episode (Hu breaks that promise).
image: the margin label is 欽定四庫全書 / 前漢書 / 五. OCR appends '次定曰事全焉' after 師古曰佗音徒何反, plus '五 / 2023年1月1日'. The garbled title reads as a quoted statement in the commentary.

image and OCR: '乙亥夕而不見'. The previous leaf: '春正月癸酉有兩龍見蘭陵家人井中', so the two dragons seen in a well on guiyou were gone by the evening of yihai. English: 'On the day yihai, the moon was eclipsed in the evening and was not seen.' The eclipse is invented and attaches a false omen to the annal. The error is real and serious. The OCR is correct here, though, so this is a seam failure (the subject is on the previous leaf), T6, rather than fluent-over-garble T7.
English gloss: "Ci Ding stated: 'The affair was thus brought to completion.'" This is rendered from the garbled margin label 欽定四庫全書. The leaf has no such commentator or statement.

image: the last commentary column ends '…柧音孤棱音' and the margin carries 欽定四庫全書 / 後漢書 / 二十一. The commentary continues on the next leaf. OCR '欠三句半之旨' is the garbled margin label. English: '<note>original: "欠三句半之旨", the commentary text breaks off here with three and a half sentences missing</note>'. This invents a lacuna, a false statement about the state of the text.

This is the same defect as tr_errors|0: the English tells the reader that three and a half sentences of commentary are missing. Nothing is missing on the leaf; the note is made from the 欽定四庫全書 margin label.

image: there is no marginal note, only 欽定四庫全書 / 後漢書 / 二十五 in the block heart. OCR '次定曰三十三司' is the garbled label. English: '<note>marginal note at bottom:</note> <margin>the sequence was fixed as thirty-three officers</margin>'. This is an invented annotation presented as part of the leaf.
This is the same defect as tr_errors|0: an invented marginal note, 'the sequence was fixed as thirty-three officers', in the English pane. The leaf has no such note.

image, right half: large-character column 2 reads '多方些稻粢穱麥挐黃粱些大苦醎酸辛甘' between '…室家遂宗食' and '行些肥牛之腱臑若芳些'. OCR goes straight from '室家遂宗食' (then the top-margin notes) to '行些肥牛之腱'. The whole main-text column is missing, while the commentary below glosses 稻, 粢, 穱, 挐, 黃梁, 大苦, 醎 and the rest from it.

image, column 4 (enlarged): '…為宰於予謂人[glyph]翼世定法出'. The glyph after 人 has a compact 日-like left part and a hooked 月-like right stroke: cursive 明, not the paired verticals of 非. OCR: '故予謂人非翼世定法出'. The polarity of the preface's claim is flipped. The page is OCR-only, and the OCR also has other misreads (故 for 於, 不得易 for 不讀易). Given the cursive hand I put this at medium confidence, but the shape favours 明.

image: in the 外臺黃芩湯 recipe, '桂枝' is followed by the small dose '一兩', clearly printed; '大棗十二枚' and '半夏半升' follow. OCR: '桂枝 / 大棗 / 十二 / 枚'. The dose of 桂枝 is dropped, so a reader of the recipe has no quantity for one of its six drugs.

image: the right leaf prints only 藝海珠塵 and the table of contents (之原 一射線不二… / 次造法用法 … / 借照作畫 一習用訣 一去垢訣). There is no line '由歐邏天學大士西泰利氏西洋鏡說'. I mirrored and enhanced the faint show-through: it reads '…也天啓六年歲次丙寅…大西洋…', the verso's dated colophon, and nothing about 西泰 or 利氏. So this line is not even a misreading of show-through. It is invented, and it attributes the work to Ricci (利西泰) instead of Schall von Bell.

image and OCR: '孫資癸巳驃騎將軍中書監劉放三月甲午司徒衛臻'. English: 'on the guisi <gloss>thirtieth</gloss> day … in the third month, on the jiawu <gloss>second</gloss> day'. The text gives ganzhi only; no day of the month is stated. The glosses are internally inconsistent: if guisi were the 30th of month 2, jiawu, the very next cycle day, would be the 1st of month 3, not the 2nd. A reader citing the annal would quote invented calendar dates.

image: the last column ends '…除邪害之患或封户刻石南向' at the foot; the next leaf opens '以報德威震本朝'. So people set up households and carve stones facing south to repay (Huangfu Song's) virtue. English: 'Some seal their doors and carve stones, turning south to declare themselves king.' 'Declare themselves king' is invented at the seam. In a speech urging Song to usurp, it misstates what Yan Zhong says.

image, first small-character column: '不及九分至二分或四分五分此太過'; the second: '不滿一寸見八分或五分六分此不及'. OCR matches. English: '…reaching only two tenths, or four or five tenths, this constitutes deficiency. … this constitutes deficiency.' The leaf contrasts 太過 with 不及; the English collapses both into 'deficiency', so it says the opposite of the first line. The source line may itself be corrupt, but the English silently rewrites it, and the reader is misled about what the leaf says.

image: a title page. 欽定四庫全書 / 史記卷一百十九 / the author and commentator lines / 循吏列傳第五十九, with the small note 索隱謂奉法循理之吏也. Then only the margin label (欽定四庫全書 / 史記 / 一). There is no line '也巳巳字一也' anywhere; it is garbled margin furniture appended as if it were text.

English: '"Also" and "already": the characters "already" and "already" are identical in form.' This philological gloss, presented right after the Suoyin note, is not on the leaf. The error is real; it is better classed as translation-side invented apparatus (T10/T7) built on the O11 garble.
image: the last Zhengyi note ends '…十以化民故次賓牟賈成第十'. The margin holds 欽定四庫全書 / 史記 / 三十五. OCR appends '次定曰軍人三書' to that note; the line is not on the leaf.

English ends the Zhengyi note with 'The next text notes: three books of military figures.' The note on the leaf ends at 成第十. The added sentence is invented and attributed to Zhang Shoujie. Better classed as T10/T7 on the translation side, built on the O11 garble.

image: the last column ends '…用充仭新秦中' with the small-character heading 集解 at the foot, and the note continues on the next leaf (李奇曰…). The margin holds 欽定四庫全書 / 史記 / 十九. OCR: '集 / 解 / 次定曰章王書'. The garbled label becomes the opening of the 集解 note, as if someone '次定' were quoted.

English: '<note>Collected Explanations: Ci Ding says: ...</note>'. The 集解 on the leaf continues on the next leaf with Li Qi (李奇曰). The commentator 'Ci Ding', made from the garbled 欽定 of the margin label, is invented. The quotation has no content, but it puts a non-existent authority into Pei Yin's apparatus.
